title: GAIA-1: A Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: driving video (frames of 288x512, output at up to 25 Hz); number of camera views not stated in packet

control_signal.value: Text prompts (e.g. weather, illumination, objects), ego action as future speed and curvature values, or a video prompt; unconditional generation also possible.

control_mechanism.value: Text, action and image tokens form one sequence for an autoregressive transformer; conditioning tokens randomly dropped in training; classifier-free guidance on token logits with scheduled scale, plus negative prompting.

base_model.value: 0.3B VQ image tokenizer distilled from DINO, 6.5B autoregressive transformer world model, and a multi-task denoising video diffusion decoder (DDIM, 50 steps).

datasets.value: Dataset names not stated in packet; described only as an expert driving dataset, with text from online narration or offline metadata.

metrics.value: No FID or FVD in the packet; reports token perplexity versus position and validation cross-entropy versus compute for scaling.

controllability_evidence.value: Qualitative only: out-of-distribution steering left or right gives matching futures with other agents reacting; text prompts change weather and illumination; text plus action combined to overtake a generated bus. No numbers.

closed_loop.value: No; open-loop rollouts from a video prompt under prescribed actions. Long unconditional rollouts shown up to +30 s via sliding window. Neural-simulator use is only suggested.

stated_limitations.value: Autoregressive generation does not yet run in real time, though it can be parallelized across samples.

notes: Packet has no quantitative controllability metric and no dataset names; fields marked accordingly. Camera configuration not visible in packet.
